manifest.timing_scope: Synchronized CUDA wallclock per independent arm: episodic reset, initial readout, candidate construction/selection, requested diagnostic views, LayerNorm optimization, final inference and reconstruction/CPU prediction transfer. Includes accounting hooks. Excludes model setup/loading, RGB decode/H2D/geometry preparation common to arms, post-run provenance checks, prediction/receipt disk writes, and offline scoring. Exclude only first complete episode (episode 0) per arm from timing aggregates; retain every prediction, count and accuracy observation including warmup.
